notes.title: Elite Encounter is officially live on Steam
notes.notes: Friends, thank you for your patience.  Elite Encounter is now life on Steam for your enjoyment.  I thank every supporter, reviewer, youtuber and everybody who's involved in making this happen.  I hope you enjoy the game and more updates to EE will sure be on the way.

notes.title: Official Release Date for Elite Encounter
notes.notes:
Hi my friends, Thank you for following Elite Encounter and thanks for your support.  The release date of Elite Encounter has been set on May 5th, 2017.  Hope you will enjoy the game and help spread the Elite Encounter Universe to your friends and family as well.  May the Elite Force with you.

Please check out a bit of write up about EE on our web site: 

https://mmeep72.wixsite.com/presskit/press-kit
